mechanics.claim: Sion's charge damage and the recast slam damage scale from minimum to maximum over the first 3 seconds of channel time, capped there even though the channel can last up to 8 seconds.
mechanics.quote: The ''base'' damage increases by {{pp|type=channel time|changedisplay=true|key=%|0 to 500/3 for 4|0 to 3|formula=55.55% every 1 second. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}} and the ''scaling'' increases by {{pp|type=channel time|changedisplay=true|key=%|0 to 100 for 4|0 to 3|formula=33.33% every 1 second. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}}

mechanics.claim: The recast slam deals the same damage as the charge-collision slam, i.e. one damage instance is dealt on whichever slam ends the ability.
mechanics.quote: Enemies, including {{tip|turret|turrets}}, hit by the slam are dealt the same damage and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 3 seconds.

mechanics.claim: An enemy can only be hit by Unstoppable Onslaught (charge or slam) once per second, limiting repeated instances against the dummy.
mechanics.quote: An enemy can only be affected by ''Unstoppable Onslaught'' once every 1 second.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not begin until the channel/leap effect ends, not on initial cast.
Sion is immune to crowd control and ghosted during the charge, which is a defensive effect not relevant to damage dealt.
Only the initial cast, not the recast, counts as an ability activation for on-cast item effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote:
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}.
**The recast does not.
